ECG findings differed between arms (asenapine: sinus bradycardia, bundle branch block; olanzapine: QRS prolongation, ST depression, T wave inversion). Metabolic profiles clearly differed, with olanzapine showing greater weight gain and metabolic abnormalities.

The trial appears to have completed as planned. The trial is best classified as 'partial' — it generated descriptive safety data but lacked formal statistical testing and a placebo comparator, limiting mechanistic inference.
